summary:
The Wall Street Journal is the newspaper at wsj.com. The blackletter nameplate in the tab is the icon article bookmarks use, saved from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against wsj.com. HTML came from https://www.wsj.com/ (HTTP 401). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.wsj.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 13094 bytes. Directory sizes: 64×64, 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.wsj.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #000000 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 7398 bytes) from https://www.wsj.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
